title: Japanese Tofu & Cauliflower Curry
subtitle: with Zesty Rice, Crispy Shallots
description: Want a veggie option that's filling and flavourful? Be swept away by this rich curry simmering with umami flavour and packed with a rainbow of veggies and tofu. Serve with fluffy rice and sprinkle with crispy shallots for some crunch.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 220°C/200°C fan-forced. Chop cauliflower (including stalk!) into small florets.
• Roughly chop carrot into bite-sized chunks. Slice brown onion into wedges. Zest lime to get a pinch and slice into wedges.
• Place cauliflower, carrot and onion on a lined oven tray. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and toss to coat.
• Roast until tender, 20-25 mins.

• Add the water (for the rice) to a medium saucepan and bring to the boil.
• Add jasmine rice, stir, cover with a lid and reduce heat to low.
• Cook for 10 mins, then remove the pan from heat and keep covered until rice is tender and all the water is absorbed, 10 mins.

• Cut Japanese tofu into 2cm chunks.
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook tofu, tossing until browned, 3-4 mins.
• Add Japanese curry paste, coconut milk, the water (for the curry) and soy sauce, stirring, until slightly reduced, 1-2 mins. Stir in roasted veggies and a squeeze of lime juice until combined, 1 minute. Season to taste.

• Once rice is done, add lime zest. Stir to combine.
• Divide zesty rice between bowls. Top with Japanese tofu and cauliflower curry. Garnish with crispy shallots and serve with any remaining lime wedges.
